mechanism: Esomeprazole may reduce torsemide's diuretic efficacy through decreased gastric pH affecting absorption, and both drugs can contribute to electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia).
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; esomeprazole use should be at the lowest effective dose and duration; consider alternative PPI or H2-blocker if prolonged therapy needed.
